body:
I'm just filing this as a reminder as a follow-up for #21139.

TL;DR that type only exists for wire compatibility with the current cache buckets, once we're bumping those buckets anyways we can delete it.

Clanker summary:

```
Once all affected buckets (sdists, flat-index, simple, and wheels) can change:
- Remove HashDigestWire, its conversions, the Serde try_from/into attribute, and the manual rkyv implementations and Verify hook.
- Replace them with the new serialization format. Archiving Digest<N> as [u8; N] would preserve its invariant without custom bytecheck verification.
- Keep validate_hex for parsing, and keep CachedHashDigests—that’s a separate storage optimization.
- Drop the "Blake2b" Serde rename only if all remaining serialized consumers can accept the new spelling.
```
title: Remove `HashDigestWire`
